description: Prepares deleting one saved address: returns the summary to show the customer and a confirmation_token. Nothing is deleted until confirm is called with it after the customer agrees. An address an order or quote was made with leaves the address book but stays on those orders and quotes, as on printdash.io. The only saved address cannot be deleted: add the new one with create_address first. When the default is deleted, the newest other address becomes the default. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.
name: delete_address

summary.description: Show this to the customer exactly as written before confirming.

title: Delete a saved address (asks first)
